description: The chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families, with the vertical axis listing the categories and the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks. The vertical axis is labeled with language families, listed in the order: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is labeled "# tasks" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with the length corresponding to the number of tasks; the bars are sorted in descending order of length. The longest bar, representing IE-Slavic, has a value of approximately 78, while the shortest bar, representing Basque, has a value of around 3. The bars decrease in length consistently from top to bottom, with representative values including IE-Romance at around 49, IE-Germanic at around 45, and Uralic at around 20. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and length.
